source_note: Verified Basic Mathematics Form Two lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary, FR. FRANK MONORUA). Term I lessons 1-26 cover rates, exchange rates, variations, geometric congruence and similarity, binary operations, formula transposition, quadratic expressions/equations, and mid-term/terminal assessments. Term II lessons 27-47 cover exponents, radicals, logarithms, set theory and Venn diagrams, and right-triangle trigonometry, plus mid-term assessments. Content kept verbatim from the educator-verified source for offline and AI generation grounding.
